title: 3.3 Am, Is, and Are
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Ask what you, she, he and they are doing, and follow each question with an answer using a familiar action.
grammar_function: What are you doing? / I am ...; What is she doing? / She is ...; What is he doing? / He is ...; What are they doing? / They are ... . Complete present-progressive exchanges using familiar Unit 1 actions; do/does is not generalized.
prerequisite: 3.2 I/you/we frames plus Unit 1 he/she/they, is/are, actions, baby and babies.
speaking_outcome: Say all four current-action questions and their matching answers in separate consecutive turns.
